text:
eli: Tiny poll  Best editor + sandwich combo for lunchtime sprints? Reply with number or add one. Options: 1) VSCode + turkey club 2) Vim + PB&J 3) Neovim + grilled cheese 4) JetBrains + salad wrap
frances: 3) Neovim + grilled cheese. Melted cheese = focus. :cheese_wedge:
tomo: 2) Vim + PB&J. Sticky keys are a feature, not a bug. :peanut:
maya: 1) VSCode + turkey club. Balanced. :sandwich:
snack-bot: Poll created  React 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣ 4️⃣ to vote. Poll closes in 4 hours.
eli: quick tally so far:
```
1: maya
2: tomo
3: frances
4: (none)
```
frances: also nominating wildcard: 5) Emacs + bagel and lox (classic breakfast-sandwich crossover).
eli: love the wildcard. if 5 wins, we demand bagels in the kitchen. :bagel:
tomo: agree on bagels, but lox is high-risk near keyboards. :grimacing:
maya: final call: adding napkin policy to README. :memo:
eli: i'll post final winner after the poll closes and bake a silly "editor sandwich" emoji mockup if people want it.
